answers.topic: What is my star sign if I was born in May
answers.fits: what is the may zodiac sign, may star sign, is may taurus or gemini, what zodiac sign is may
answers.text:
May holds two star signs, so the answer depends on the exact day. Birthdays from May 1 to May 20 are Taurus. Birthdays from May 21 to May 31 are Gemini.

The two are neighbors in the calendar and opposites in temperament. Taurus is fixed earth: steady, loyal, sensory, slow to change. Gemini is mutable air: curious, talkative, quick to adapt, bored easily. A May 10 birthday and a May 25 birthday share a month and almost nothing else.

If the birthday sits on May 19, 20, 21 or 22, it falls in the cusp window. The Sun changes signs at a precise moment that shifts by hours each year, so a May 21 birthday can be Taurus in one year and Gemini in another. A birth chart, calculated from the date, time and place, settles it properly. Generic lists cannot.

One practical note: your star sign is only the Sun sign. A full chart includes the Moon and rising sign, which is why two people with the same May birthday can read so differently.

answers.fits: are tarot readings accurate, do tarot cards really work, can tarot predict the future, how accurate is tarot
answers.text:
Honest answer: tarot is not a prediction machine, and readers who promise certainty about the future are overselling. No card system can tell you what will happen with accuracy you can measure.

What tarot does well is reflection. A reading lays out symbols: the Hermit for withdrawal, the Chariot for direction, the Tower for upheaval. Those symbols give you a vocabulary for what you already sense but have not named. People often finish a good reading saying "I knew that, I just had not said it out loud." That recognition is the accuracy they are describing.

The unhealthy version is outsourcing decisions to the cards: pulling again until the answer changes, or staying in something because a card felt favorable. The healthy version treats a reading like a structured journal prompt. One card, one honest question, one action you control.

If you want to test this yourself, ask a question where you already know the honest answer and watch what the card makes you admit. That is where tarot earns its keep.

answers.topic: What does Taurus personality look like
answers.fits: what are taurus traits, taurus personality, what are tauruses like, taurus strengths and weaknesses
answers.text:
Taurus season runs from April 20 to May 20, and the sign is fixed earth ruled by Venus. In plain terms: the steadiest temperament in the zodiac.

The strengths are real. Taurus is patient, loyal, and finishes what everyone else abandoned in week two. It has the most physical, sensory nature of the twelve signs: good food, comfortable rooms, quality over quantity, especially with money. A Taurus budget is rarely exciting and rarely wrong.

The weaknesses come from the same root. Taurus stays: in jobs, friendships and arguments past their end date, because leaving feels like waste. The famous stubbornness is really patience with the brakes cut. And the calm has a long fuse with a memorable ending; the sign absorbs irritation for months, files it, then erupts over something small.

In love, Taurus shows rather than tells: cooked meals, fixed shelves, promises kept. It pairs well with Virgo and Scorpio. If you are close to a Taurus, the one skill worth learning is to ask early, because they will not volunteer a complaint until it has become a case file.
